_comment: USER-FOUND, 2026-09-03 (play viewer, EldraziDisplacerFlicker seed 1 turn 3): a rules-legal
two-cast line the engine refused to offer. 'land=Mariposa Military Base; cast=Trace of
Abundance; cast=Living Wish' verdicted legal_not_enumerated -- 40 plans at that decision, NONE
of them casting two spells.
THE THIRD SYMPTOM of the is_land_aura root cause fixed in 34abe486 ('one root cause, two
symptoms'). IsAuraOnNewCreature scans the battlefield for a CREATURE carrying the Aura's
enchant_target m_number; an 'enchant LAND' Aura's host is a LAND, so the scan never matched and
the predicate returned TRUE for every land Aura. The other two sites merely mis-offered or
over-rejected a subset. This one DELETES: OrderingPlacesAuraBeforeCreature rejects every
ordering of the set and the loop `continue`s past all of them, so the whole plan is dropped
with no fallback.
WHY NO SUITE EVER SAW IT, and why this fixture needs the env block. The deletion happens in the
cast-ORDERING search, which is gated on UnprunedGate::SearchOrder -- default OFF, so autonomous
play (and therefore every GT tier) never ran it. --claude-play sets MTG_UNPRUNED=1 (main.cpp),
which opens that gate, so the bug was reachable ONLY through the play viewer / the claude-play
oracle: the human was refused a line the autonomous search would happily keep. The env block
below reproduces that condition; WITHOUT it this fixture passes on the unfixed binary, which is
the whole reason it has to be here rather than in a plain scenario.
Verified DISCRIMINATING both ways: on the unfixed binary this fixture verdicts
legal_not_enumerated, on the fixed one it verdicts accept. On the real seed-1 board the same
pair of runs reads legal_not_enumerated (EnumeratePlans built 16 'Trace of Abundance + Living
Wish' plans and the ordering pass handed back 11 with none of them) vs choose, offering Trace
of Abundance -> Aether Hub with Living Wish -> Cloud of Faeries.
The fixture: Aether Hub taps for {C} and, with the two Wild Growths on it, adds {G}{G} -- three
mana from one land. Conservatory adds a fourth (G/W). Trace of Abundance is {R/W}{G} and Living
Wish is {1}{G}, so the pair costs exactly the four available: a TOTAL-mana-tight board, which
is what makes the verdict a statement about enumeration rather than about affordability. The
verdict is 'accept' rather than 'choose' only because the filler library leaves the Wish a
single legal fetch; on the real board, where it has eight, the same line verdicts 'choose'.
validate_line: land=Mariposa Military Base;cast=Trace of Abundance;cast=Living Wish
